The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Runs the same checks in CI as the hook (hooks can be skipped), using the production database engine and cache as service containers with health checks
- Includes migrate, a missing-migration check, tests with a coverage floor, lint, a secret scan and manage.py check --deploy
- Requires pull requests and passing checks on the default branch, pins third-party actions to a full commit hash and sets least-privilege permissions

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
